Special Branch,
August 4, 1936.

CC

Whereabouts of Francis Eugene McGarvin,
American.

With reference to the attached communication
dated July 6, 1936 from Messrs. Harris, Willey,
Griffith & Harris, Fresno, California, enquiring as
to whether one Francis Eugene McGarvin is alive or
dead, I have to report that this gentleman is alive and
well. He is residing at No. 2254 Zi-Ka-Wei (Chinese
Territory).

Do not send

Certified true copy.

J Harbair

抄送

美籍人士弗朗西斯·尤金·麦加文（Francis Eugene McGarvin）之下落。

兹提及附后之1936年7月6日来自加利福尼亚州弗雷斯诺市哈里斯、威利、格里菲思和哈里斯律师事务所（Messrs. Harris, Willey, Griffith & Harris）的来函，该函询问弗朗西斯·尤金·麦加文尚在人世或已故。本人须报告称，该先生健在且安好。其现居住于徐家汇（中国地界）2254号。

勿发送

经核证无误之副本。

J Harbair

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. D. REGISTRY
S. B. D. 7482
Date 29 7 36

July
6th
1936

Chief of Police
Shanghai, China

Dear Sir:

On behalf of the sister of FRANCIS EUGENE Mc-
GARVIN, whose last address was No. 53 Avenue Petain,
Shanghai, China, will you kindly advise me if he is
now living or dead.

His sister has information to the effect that
he is dead. If he is dead, will you kindly advise me
when he died and whether or not he left any estate, and
with whom I may communicate as to the details of his
death and where he is buried and what estate, if any, he
left.

Thanking you in advance for your courtesy in
this matter, I am

Yours very truly

Frank A. Willey
FOR HARRIS, WILLEY, GRIFFITH & HARRIS

FAW.A

1936年

警察局长
中国上海

尊敬的先生：

受弗朗西斯·尤金·麦加文（FRANCIS EUGENE Mc-GARVIN）之姐妹委托，其最后住址为中国上海贝当路（Avenue Petain）53号，恳请阁下告知我他目前尚在人世或已故。

其姐妹获悉的消息表明他已去世。若他确已去世，恳请阁下告知我其死亡时间，以及是否留有任何遗产，并告知我可就其死亡详情、埋葬地点以及所留遗产（如有）等事宜与何人联系。

预先感谢阁下在此事上的礼遇，

您真诚的

弗兰克·A·威利
代表哈里斯、威利、格里菲思和哈里斯律师事务所

FAW.A
